status_definitions.ACTIVE: Currently in delivery under AfariLabs-OS governance, lifecycle in progress.
status_definitions.COMPLETED: Delivered through its full lifecycle (or, for a project predating AfariLabs-OS, delivered and closed) and retained in the portfolio.
status_definitions.PILOT: The project currently validating AfariLabs-OS itself by being run through the complete lifecycle for the first time.
status_definitions.ARCHIVED: No longer active or maintained; retained for historical/reference purposes only.

field_definitions.name: Display name.
field_definitions.classification: Free-text project category, e.g. 'Reference Project', 'Internal AfariLabs Product', 'Client Engagement'. Not a closed enum — the specification does not define a fixed list.
field_definitions.description: Short, factual description. Must not state anything not verifiable from the OS specification or the project's own repository.
field_definitions.owner: Person or role accountable for the project. Null if not assigned/recorded.
field_definitions.repository: Name of the execution-plane repository holding the implementation, if any. Null if none exists yet.
field_definitions.created_date: ISO 8601 date the project was registered or started. Null if not recorded.
field_definitions.technology: Array of technologies actually used/confirmed. Null if not yet known or not documented — never inferred or guessed.
field_definitions.capabilities_used: Array of capability area(s) from capabilities/ (automation, application, ai, experience, security, client-success, delivery) actually engaged. Null if none yet.
field_definitions.lifecycle_stage: Current stage per the 15-stage lifecycle (DISCOVER..LEARN, see CLAUDE.md), or null if not started. Use 'N/A' with a note for a project that predates AfariLabs-OS and is not being tracked retroactively through the lifecycle.
field_definitions.security_status: Status of the Security Review gate for this project. Null/'Not reviewed' if not yet reached.
field_definitions.evaluation_status: Status of the AI Evaluation gate for this project, if applicable. Null if not applicable or not yet reached.
field_definitions.deployment_status: Current deployment state (e.g. 'Not deployed', 'Deployed', 'Decommissioned'). Null if not documented.
field_definitions.lessons: Array of references into knowledge/lessons/ captured from this project. Empty array if none captured yet.
field_definitions.patterns: Array of references into knowledge/patterns/ this project has contributed, once validated. Empty array if none yet.
field_definitions.related_projects: Array of other project_id values this project is technically or organizationally related to. Empty array if no relationship is documented.

projects.name: PMRaid
projects.description: A completed AfariLabs project retained in the portfolio as evidence of existing capability. Used as a reference architecture, product demonstration, case study and portfolio asset. It is not the first validation pilot for AfariLabs-OS, and AfariLabs-OS was not used to build it — this must not be claimed otherwise. (Spec Section 20)
projects.lifecycle_stage: N/A — completed prior to AfariLabs-OS; not tracked retroactively through the OS lifecycle

projects.name: Desta Cold Store Project
projects.description: The first internal AfariLabs product to be run through the complete AfariLabs-OS lifecycle — the proving ground for the operating system. Treated as an internal AfariLabs product, not a client engagement. Not yet started; its application and repository must not be built ahead of actual lifecycle work. (Spec Sections 20-22)
